# Hari Govind

Hari Govind is President & CEO of brk tech, a Berkshire Hathaway company,
since February 2026.

He leads brk tech, a technology organization built to transform Berkshire
Hathaway's businesses by empowering them with a cutting-edge tech and AI
advantage — turning technology buyers into builders.

## Current roles

- President & CEO, brk tech (February 2026 — present)
- Chief Technical Advisor, Group Companies, Berkshire Hathaway (October 2024 — present)
- Chief Technology Officer, BNSF Railway (January 2025 — present)

## Previous roles

- Chief Information & Technology Officer, GEICO (February 2023 — November 2024)
- Senior Vice President, Engineering, Target (2019 — 2023)
- General Manager, Platform & Infrastructure, Facebook (May 2015 — July 2019)
- Senior Director, Bing | Xbox, Microsoft (January 2006 — April 2015)
- Engineering Fellow, Honeywell (January 2003 — January 2006)
- Head of Engineering, Products and Operations, Microland Group Co. (September 1999 — January 2003)

## Education

- Doctoral Studies, College of Engineering, Penn State University
- M.S., College of Engineering, Purdue University

## Focus

Applied AI, digital transformation, transformational leadership, hybrid cloud,
cyber resilience, developer velocity, open source, enterprise technology
transformation.
